acceptance: 1) Open controls through footer analytics-preferences in a real browser. Without consent/with rejection, do not generate/store analytics IDs or send events, while pages/3D remain usable. After consent, a completed real navigation produces page_view and retries with the same navigationId do not duplicate it (E-42). 2) Withdrawal immediately stops collection, clears local analytics IDs/pending queues and does not backfill withdrawn-period visits. If false is selected while true is in flight, serialize cookie clearing according to the latest intent; out-of-order responses cannot reopen collection (E-43). 3) Use only section 11 minimalist-flat and sections 07/12 wiring. At 1920x1080/1440x900/390x844 retain actual-request GIF/computed-style evidence; keyboard and 44px touch targets remain usable. 4) In a real browser use footer privacy-link to /[locale]/privacy. Corresponding en/ru content explicitly states Number of anonymous browsers that consented to analytics. Isolated tests separately change device contexts, clear identifiers and switch browsers, verifying that a new browserHash can form while recording only whether it differs, not its raw value. Do not claim unique real-person or cross-device identification (E-45). 5) Explain necessary chat cookies, analytics consent, default dry-run and actual retention-authorization boundaries separately. Preserve the existing noindex/completeness rules. Show the site-IANA time zone and raw/aggregate query ranges consistently with backend configuration reads.

E-42.scene: C-05 Analytics collection, deduplication and retention
E-42.trigger: The user has not allowed analytics or has rejected it
E-42.expect: Do not create/store analytics identifiers or send analytics events; the site and 3D functions remain usable. The dashboard must clearly cover only consented browsers and must not turn missing nonconsented samples into a whole-site visitor count.

E-43.scene: C-05 Analytics collection, deduplication and retention
E-43.expect: Stop collection, discard unsent analytics events and clear local analytics identifiers. Do not send visits from the withdrawn-consent period afterward.

E-45.scene: C-05 Analytics collection, deduplication and retention
E-45.trigger: The same person switches devices, clears identifiers or uses another browser
E-45.expect: State Number of anonymous browsers that consented to analytics in the visitor definition/help. Separately test device switching, identifier clearing and browser switching, each of which can create a new browserHash. Do not claim unique real-person or cross-device identification.
